title: Assam Buranji (1884)
author: Gunabhiram Barua
description: Milestone modern history of Assam by Rai Bahadur Gunabhiram Barua, synthesizing Tai Ahom manuscripts, Sanskrit copper inscriptions, and British records into a progressive, scientific narrative of Assam from ancient mythological eras to the late nineteenth century.

sentences.free_translation_en: The six-century reign of the Tai Ahom dynasty laid the political foundation of modern Assam.
sentences.free_translation_as: টাই আহোম ৰাজবংশৰ ছশ বছৰীয়া শাসনে আধুনিক অসমৰ ৰাজনৈতিক ভেটি স্থাপন কৰিলে।
sentences.speaker: Rai Bahadur Gunabhiram Barua (Historian & Reformer)
sentences.notes: Opening historical appraisal in Gunabhiram Barua's Assam Buranji.
